item.title: WATCH: Starmer Refuses to Set Date for Delayed Defence Investment Plan
item.description: Starmer, red as a beetroot, with no explanation for the delayed Defence Investment Plan. This was supposed to have been published last autumn. Have they lost it down the back of the sofa?

item.title: Partners of Sitting & Former Labour MPs Arrested on Suspicion of Spying for China
item.description: The partner of a sitting Labour MP and the partner of a former Labour MP are among the three men arrested by counter terror police on suspicion of spying for China. A 39-year-old in London, 68-year-old in Powys & 43-year-old in Pontyclun are in custody. The Met is not naming them. Labour in the spotlight……

item.title: British Unemployment Rate Now Higher Than Italy’s
item.description: New statistics released in Italy now show that unemployment is now higher in Britain: Italy’s unemployment rate fell to 5.1% in January, the lowest since 2004. Britain’s rose to 5.2% in last month’s ONS release. Up from 3.6% in 2022… The OBR forecast yesterday that unemployment will rise to 5.33% before falling. Thank you Rachel…
